checked_boundaries: normalization review identity and predecessor receipt are checked before coverage promotion
per-example review dispositions and claim counts are checked
case source inventories and original anchor paths are checked
packets omit case/answer/example IDs and expectations
predictions are persisted before expectations enter measurement
outcome metrics distinguish misses, false rejects, abstentions, invalids, and claim relation/span matches
external_effect_authority: none; offline local tests and one authorized offline development run only
remaining_limits: The reviewed data and expectations are known development examples; this cannot establish generalization or independent accuracy.
The checker consumes manually normalized selected fragments and cannot validate semantic extraction or whole-answer completeness.
For no-support claims, generic typed matching lists inspected sources but does not reconstruct the tempting premise when it has a different predicate; post-run reason review remains necessary.
An in-process Python audit hook is a bounded offline guard, not an OS network sandbox or an external security proof.
Review receipts and hashes live in the same local workspace and are not signatures or externally sealed authority.

resolved_findings.initial: An unrestricted hard ban missed a recurring duty.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit quantifier=all now covers matching role duties, with role and explicit schedule scope checks.

resolved_findings.initial: Unrelated preferences and requirements sharing an object could produce a false pass.
resolved_findings.resolution: Compatibility joins on predicate and assessed scope; quantitative conditions abstain rather than pass.

resolved_findings.initial: A fragment with no claim atoms returned pass.
check_claim accepted changed sources under a stale source digest.
resolved_findings.resolution: Direct calls validate source SHA binding.

resolved_findings.initial: Evaluation instructions in some source kinds lacked the source-role trace.
resolved_findings.resolution: Evaluation_instruction does not grant evaluation authority regardless of source kind.

resolved_findings.initial: Universal preference logic could import a different role or explicit schedule requirement.
resolved_findings.resolution: Counterfactual role/schedule tests now pass; D08 broad-duty matching remains covered.
